The "'''Anti-Mandalore'''" was the term used by the radical [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group known as [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], to describe the leader of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]. Both groups put forward their own claimants to the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]—the traditional ruler of the Mandalorian people<ref name="TBHC" />—in opposition to the ''Mand'alor'' chosen by the traditional [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans,<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> with Death Watch following their own [[Secret Mandalore]].<ref name="TBHC" />

==Notable "Anti-Mandalores"==
===Satine Kryze===
{{Main|Satine Kryze/Legends}}
[[File:SatineKryze-Corruption.png|thumb|right|200px|Satine Kryze]]
{{Quote|War is intolerable. We have been deceived into thinking that we must be a part of it. I say the moment we committed to fighting, we already lost.|Satine Kryze|audio=WarIsIntolerable-VoT.flac|<ref name="VoT">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>}}
The daughter of the [[Satine Kryze's father/Legends|Duke]] of [[Clan Kryze/Legends|Clan Kryze]], Satine Kryze hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]]. During the [[Great Clan Wars/Legends|Great Clan Wars]], as the Death Watch attempted to overthrow the New Mandalorian regime in a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] civil war, Kryze's [[Parent/Legends|father]] sent [[Gender/Legends|her]] away to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>—[[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>—in order to gain an education in [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] and [[Politics/Legends|statecraft]], and be free of the violence that would eventually claim the clan leader's life. When Kryze returned to the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], she did so under the protection of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]; for [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Kryze was under constant threat from the Death Watch and its allies, but as time went on, Kryze was able to use the skills she had learned and her own charisma to rally war-weary [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]] to the New Mandalorian cause and bring about peace. Following the end of the Great Clan Wars, Kryze was appointed ''Mand'alor'' by the New Mandalorian people,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> in opposition to Jango Fett, who held claim to the title among the warrior clans,<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and Death Watch's Secret Mandalore, [[Tor Vizsla]].<ref name="TBHC" /> As ''Mand'alor'' of the New Mandalorians,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> Kryze set about rebuilding the damage incurred to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]<ref name="VoT" /> during the Great Clan Wars, leading New Mandalorian society and its capital [[City/Legends|city]] [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> to prosperity.<ref name="TMP">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>

Upon the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kryze strove to ensure Mandalore would remain neutral in the conflict, though the peace she had made came under siege by the re-emergence of the Death Watch.<ref name="TMP" /> Though Kryze was able to overcome their initial [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|schemes]] and [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|attempts]] on her life<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> to solidify Mandalore's neutrality, as the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Wars went on, her rule was marred with severe [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] shortages, a rise in [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|corruption]], and mass [[Poison/Legends|poisonings]] throughout New Mandalorian territory as a result of toxin-laced [[Tea/Legends|tea]] imported by [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="Corruption" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Death Watch allied with the criminal contingent known as the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] to bring down the New Mandalorians: public opinion swayed against Kryze as offworld [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] from [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] mercilessly [[Blaster/Legends|gunned]] down civilians and caused panic, only for the Death Watch to arrive and act as saviors of the people, defeating and arresting their secret allies in a show of apparent heroism. With the support of her people gone, Kryze was [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|deposed]] and [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]], replaced by Pre Vizsla,<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" /> the Death Watch's latest Secret Mandalore.<ref name="TBHC" /> [[Standard week/Legends|Weeks]] later, when her old friend Obi-Wan Kenobi came to Mandalore in order to rescue Kryze from [[Prison/Legends|prison]], she was [[Shiak|murdered]] before the Jedi Master's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who had been in collusion with Vizsla during his coup and sought to pain Kenobi with his one-time lover's death.<ref name="ShadowConspiracy" />
